item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Driver charged with DUI after entering fatal Hillsborough County crash scene: HCSO
item.description: A driver was arrested Sunday morning after deputies said he drove into an active fatal crash scene while impaired on Bruce B. Downs Boulevard, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office.

[BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 2 dead, 5 injured in shooting at Seattle food festival
item.description: Two people were killed and five others were wounded in a shooting Sunday evening during a food festival at an events complex near the Space Needle in Seattle, a city fire department spokesperson said.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'Left in the dark': Families say they weren't notified during Aviata evacuation
item.description: Multiple families tell Tampa Bay 28 they didn't know their loved ones were being evacuated or where they were taken.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa Bay Lightning host ninth annual Bolts Brew Fest
item.description: The Tampa Bay Lightning hosted the ninth annual Bolts Brew Fest, bringing together local and national breweries and distilleries for a night of sampling and entertainment.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] SR-60 railroad crossing closure expected to cause major delays in Polk County
item.description: Drivers traveling between Bartow and Lake Wales should expect heavy traffic delays starting Monday morning as a railroad crossing closure shuts down part of State Road 60 for two weeks.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa Bay husband takes on 31-mile walk to support wife living with Parkinson's, raise money for research
item.description: Joe Gaeta says Parkinson's disease has changed nearly every part of his family's life. But instead of letting the diagnosis define them, he's channeling his energy into raising awareness and money for research, one step at a time.
